itemFields.default: Say what it is and what it is for.

default.name: Stoneware clay
default.text: Speckled buff stoneware, wedged and ready to use straight from the bag. Enough for six mugs or one ambitious vase.

default.name: Wooden tools
default.text: Rib, needle, wire cutter, sponge and a loop tool for trimming.

default.name: Video lessons
default.text: From pinch pots to a lidded jar, taught by Ines at her bench.

default.name: Glaze tokens
default.text: Choose your colours from 12 house glazes when you drop off.

default.name: Kiln firing
default.text: We bisque and glaze fire up to six pieces at 1,240 °C.

default.name: Return carton
default.text: A padded carton and a prepaid label, so your pots travel back to the studio in one piece. Collect them two weeks later.
